adam-english-radio-presenter: Adam English is a British radio presenter and comedian whose broadcasting work includes breakfast and drivetime shows on Union JACK Radio. His drivetime programme also aired across Union JACK Rock and Union JACK Dance. Alongside radio, he has explored stand-up comedy and hosted the station's Ones to Watch podcast, introducing audiences to emerging comedy performers.
adam-kay-comedian: Adam Kay is a writer, comedian and former junior doctor best known for This Is Going to Hurt, his bestselling account of life on the NHS frontline. He also adapted the book for television. His other titles include Twas the Nightshift Before Christmas and Undoctored, while younger readers know him through Kay's Anatomy and Kay's Marvellous Medicine.
ainsley-harriott-presenter-chef: Ainsley Harriott is a British chef, television presenter and cookbook author best known for Ready Steady Cook and Can't Cook, Won't Cook. He trained at Westminster College and worked in professional kitchens before becoming a familiar face on television. His programmes combine practical recipes with his unmistakable enthusiasm, and he received an MBE in 2020 for services to broadcasting and the culinary arts.
amanda-lamb-tv-presenter: Amanda Lamb is a British television presenter and former model best known for helping house hunters explore overseas properties on Channel 4's A Place in the Sun. Her presenting credits also include You Deserve This House. Before her television career, she spent ten years as the face of Scottish Widows, appearing in the company's distinctive advertising campaigns.
andy-hamilton-comedian-writer: Andy Hamilton is a British comedian, writer and performer whose work spans television, radio and fiction. With Guy Jenkin, he co-created the sitcoms Drop the Dead Donkey and Outnumbered. He also wrote and starred in BBC Radio 4's Old Harry's Game, playing Satan, and is known to panel-show audiences for his dry humour and quick responses.
anna-jane-cassey-actress: Anna-Jane Casey is a British actress, singer and dancer with an extensive career in musical theatre. Her stage credits include Cats, Chicago, West Side Story and Starlight Express, alongside appearances in London productions of Grease and Joseph and the Amazing Technicolor Dreamcoat. She has performed leading roles in both West End and regional productions, combining acting with singing and dance.
barry-mcguigan-boxer: Barry McGuigan is an Irish former boxer, broadcaster and boxing promoter known as the Clones Cyclone. He won the WBA featherweight world title in 1985 by defeating Eusebio Pedroza in London, having also held British and European titles. Following his retirement from the ring, he moved into commentary and promotion, extending a career closely associated with professional boxing.
ben-adams-a1-singer: Ben Adams is a British singer and songwriter best known as a member of the British-Norwegian pop group a1. The band's hits include Take On Me, Same Old Brand New You and Caught in the Middle. His work with a1 includes both performing and songwriting, with writing credits on the latter two singles alongside his fellow band members and collaborators.
ben-nealon-actor-obe: Ben Nealon is a British actor best known for playing Jeremy Forsythe in ITV's Soldier Soldier. His screen work includes the Indian films Lagaan and Mangal Pandey: The Rising, alongside television drama and stage productions. Away from acting, he has supported the water and sanitation charity Pump Aid and received an OBE in 2012 for his services to the organisation.
big-john-harrison-radio-presenter: Big John Harrison is a radio presenter associated with South Yorkshire's Hallam FM breakfast show, Big John at Breakfast. Working alongside Liesl Soards and producer James Crookes, he became a familiar voice for listeners across the region. The team's broadcasting partnership also continued through a weekly podcast, bringing their conversation and comedy to audiences beyond the original breakfast programme.
brendan-rodgers-leicester-city-manager: Brendan Rodgers is a Northern Irish football manager whose career has included Swansea City, Liverpool, Celtic and Leicester City. He took Swansea into the Premier League and later led Liverpool during their 2013-14 title challenge. His managerial work has spanned English and Scottish football, building on a coaching career that began after injury curtailed his ambitions as a player.
brendan-o-carroll-actor-mrs-brown: Brendan O'Carroll is an Irish comedian, actor and writer best known as the creator and performer of Agnes Brown in Mrs Brown's Boys. The character developed across his stage and television work, with the sitcom becoming a major BBC and RTÉ production. Born in Dublin, O'Carroll has also worked as a producer and director, bringing the Brown family's comedy to wider audiences.
calvin-moyo-boxer: Calvin Moyo is a Zimbabwe-born professional boxer associated with Doncaster and the South Yorkshire boxing scene. He made a winning professional debut in 2024, beating Sheffield's Paul Scaife on points over four rounds on a GBM promotion. Moyo has also worked as an engineering technician, balancing his career outside the ring with training and competition in professional boxing.
captain-sensible-singer: Captain Sensible is the stage name of Raymond Burns, a British singer, songwriter and musician who co-founded The Damned. Initially the band's bassist, he later moved to guitar and also established a solo career. His version of Happy Talk reached number one in the UK in 1982, while Wot became another recognisable solo hit alongside his work in punk rock.
catherine-tyldesley-actor: Catherine Tyldesley is a British actress and singer best known for playing Eva Price in Coronation Street. Her television work also includes Iris Moss in the BBC drama Lilies and Karen Norris in the sitcom Scarborough. A graduate of Birmingham School of Acting, she has worked across drama, comedy and music, as well as appearing as a contestant on Strictly Come Dancing.
cherry-bear-mascot: Cherry Bear is AFC Bournemouth's club mascot, representing the Cherries and meeting supporters as part of the matchday experience. The mascot appears in the club's family activities and pre-match entertainment, helping younger fans enjoy their visit to the stadium. With a name inspired by Bournemouth's club nickname, Cherry Bear brings a playful character to the team's supporter events.
chris-smith-radio-presenter: Chris Smith is a British author and broadcaster known for his work as a newsreader on BBC Radio 1's Newsbeat. With Greg James, he created the Kid Normal children's book series and co-hosted the That's What He Said podcast. His solo writing includes Frankie Best Hates Quests, bringing his career from radio news into children's fiction and storytelling.
chris-walker-actor: Chris Walker is a British actor and director best known for playing police officer Rob Hollins in the BBC daytime drama Doctors. He portrayed the character from 2009 until the programme's final episode in 2024. His other television roles include Matthew Mullen in Playing the Field, and he shared a British Soap Award with his Doctors co-star Jan Pearson.
chris-wilder-sheffield-united-manager: Chris Wilder is an English football manager and former player whose career is closely associated with Sheffield United. He guided the Blades to the League One title in 2017 and promotion to the Premier League in 2019. His management work has also included other English clubs, following a playing career in which he operated as a right-back.
claudia-winkleman-presenter: Claudia Winkleman is a British television and radio presenter known for her work on Strictly Come Dancing, The Traitors and Channel 4's The Piano. Her career includes entertainment, film coverage and broadcasting, with programmes ranging from dance competitions to social-strategy games. Her distinctive presenting style combines humour and conversation across several different formats, making her a recognisable figure on British television.
clinton-baptise-psychic: Clinton Baptiste is the fictional clairvoyant created and performed by comedian Alex Lowe. First seen in Peter Kay's Phoenix Nights, the character is known for his confidently disastrous readings and awkward messages from the spirit world. Lowe has developed the act into live shows and touring performances, giving audiences more of the comedy medium's questionable predictions and spectacularly misplaced confidence.
colin-patterson-bbc: Colin Paterson is a Scottish journalist and broadcaster known for arts and entertainment reporting for the BBC. His career has included presenting and reporting on BBC Three's Liquid News, as well as earlier work for The Big Breakfast. His reporting covers the people and stories behind music, film and television, bringing entertainment news to broadcast audiences.
colson-smith-actor: Colson Smith is a British actor best known for playing Craig Tinker in Coronation Street between 2011 and 2025. Born in Dorchester and raised in Castleford, he became familiar to viewers through the character's journey on the ITV soap. He has also appeared in television competitions, including The Games in 2022 and Celebrity Big Brother in 2024.
craig-gazey-actor: Craig Gazey is a British stage and television actor best known for playing Graeme Proctor in Coronation Street. His comic performance on the ITV soap earned him a British Soap Award for Best Comedy Performance. He trained at the Royal Welsh College of Music and Drama and has also worked in theatre and appeared in the television drama Criminal Justice.
damian-williams-actor: Damian Williams is a British actor and comedy performer whose screen credits include Whiff in the children's series Andy and the Band. He also played Tommy Cooper in the short film The Last Laugh and appeared in the television series Up North. His work combines character comedy and acting, with performances across children's entertainment and other screen productions.
dan-gillespie-the-felling-singer: Dan Gillespie Sells is a British singer, songwriter and guitarist best known as the lead vocalist of The Feeling. The band's songs include Sewn and Fill My Little World, both of which carry his songwriting credits. His musical work also extends to theatre, including composing the score for Everybody's Talking About Jamie, bringing his songwriting from pop records to the stage.
dan-walker-bbc-breakfast: Dan Walker is a British journalist and broadcaster whose career spans sport, news and entertainment. He presented Football Focus for twelve years and BBC Breakfast for six before moving to Channel 5 News. His television work also includes The One Show and Songs of Praise, alongside coverage of major sporting events including World Cups, Olympic Games and Wimbledon.
dave-vitty-comedian: Dave Vitty is a British radio presenter and writer widely known as Comedy Dave from The Chris Moyles Show on BBC Radio 1. He became a familiar part of the programme after beginning as a broadcast assistant. His work has also included television appearances and entertainment projects, extending his broadcasting profile beyond the radio studio and his long-running on-air partnership with Moyles.
david-baddiel-comedian: David Baddiel is a British comedian, author and television presenter who became known through The Mary Whitehouse Experience and his comedy partnership with Rob Newman. He later worked with Frank Skinner across comedy and football-related entertainment. His career also includes writing fiction and non-fiction, bringing the observation and humour of his performance work into books for different audiences.
david-davies-former-executive-director-o: David Davies is a British broadcaster and football administrator who served as executive director of the Football Association. Before his work in football, his broadcasting career included reporting for BBC Wales and presenting or contributing to programmes such as Look North West and Nationwide. He received an OBE in 2007 for services to sport, reflecting his work in football administration.
david-diamante-boxing-commentator: David Diamante is an American ring announcer whose voice is associated with major professional boxing events. His work includes broadcasts for DAZN, and he is recognisable for repeating fighters' surnames during introductions. Away from announcing, he founded a cigar lounge in Brooklyn. His career has also been recognised by the New York State Boxing Hall of Fame.
dene-michaels-singer: Dene Michael is a British singer associated with Black Lace, the pop group known for party records including Agadoo. He joined the band in the 1980s, becoming part of its live and recording history after its best-known breakthrough hits. His screen credits include an appearance with Black Lace in Rita, Sue and Bob Too, linking his music career with British film.
dermot-o-leary-radio-presenter: Dermot O'Leary is a British broadcaster whose television career includes The X Factor, Big Brother's Little Brother and This Morning. He has also worked in radio, including XFM and BBC Radio 2. His presenting experience covers live entertainment, interviews and music programmes, making him familiar to both television viewers and radio listeners across a wide range of formats.
dolly-rose-campbell-actress: Dolly-Rose Campbell is a British actress best known for playing Gemma Winter in Coronation Street, a role she began in 2014. Gemma's storylines have included becoming a mother to quadruplets, giving Campbell both comic and dramatic material on the ITV soap. Her other screen credits include Doctors and the film Bound, alongside her long association with the cobbles.
emily-atack-actress: Emily Atack is a British actress, comedian and television personality who became known as Charlotte Hinchcliffe in The Inbetweeners. Her screen career includes The Emily Atack Show, Tracey Ullman's Show and the television adaptation of Rivals. She has worked across scripted comedy, impressions and entertainment, moving between acting roles and programmes built around her own comedy performances.
everal-a-walsh-actor: Everal A. Walsh is a British actor and voice performer whose work spans film, television, theatre and games. His screen credits include The Favourite, Prime Suspect 5 and The Selfish Giant. He has also appeared in Max and Paddy's Road to Nowhere and performed voice roles in games such as The Witcher and Sacred 3, alongside work in radio drama.
faye-tozer-singer-dancer: Faye Tozer is a British singer, dancer and actress best known as a member of the pop group Steps. The band's catalogue includes Tragedy and Deeper Shade of Blue, combining pop vocals with choreographed performances. Her career also includes stage work and an appearance on Strictly Come Dancing in 2018, bringing her experience in music and dance to television competition.
frank-skinner-comedian: Frank Skinner is a British comedian, writer and broadcaster whose career spans stand-up, television and radio. He is closely associated with fellow comedian David Baddiel, with whom he co-wrote and performed Three Lions alongside the Lightning Seeds. His work also includes books and live comedy, combining personal storytelling with the observations that established his name in British entertainment.
freddie-parrot-face-davies-comedian: Freddie Davies is a British comedian and actor known for his Parrot Face persona. He came to national attention through Opportunity Knocks in 1964 before building a career in live comedy and television. His acting credits include Heartbeat, Casualty and Last of the Summer Wine, showing a screen career that extends beyond the comedy character audiences first knew.
gareth-southgate-england-football-manage: Gareth Southgate is an English football manager and former international player who led England's men's team from 2016 to 2024. Under his management, England reached the 2018 World Cup semi-final and the finals of Euro 2020 and Euro 2024. His earlier career included playing for his country and club football before moving into management with Middlesbrough.
george-sampson-actor: George Sampson is a British dancer and actor who won the second series of Britain's Got Talent in 2008. His street-dance performances led to work in the West End production Into the Hoods and the films StreetDance 3D and StreetDance 2. He has also appeared in television drama, building an acting career alongside the dance performances that first brought him national attention.
gok-wan-tv-personality: Gok Wan is a British fashion stylist, television presenter, author and DJ. He became widely known through How to Look Good Naked and went on to present programmes including Gok's Fashion Fix and Gok Cooks Chinese. His broadcasting work brings together fashion, food and entertainment, while his wider career includes writing and music alongside his television presenting.
graeme-garden-comedian: Graeme Garden is a British comedian, actor and writer best known as one of The Goodies and for his work on I'm Sorry I Haven't a Clue. His career has combined television comedy with radio performance, writing and script editing. He received an OBE in 2011 for services to light entertainment, alongside his fellow Goodies performer Tim Brooke-Taylor.
graziano-prima-dancer: Graziano Di Prima is an Italian professional dancer and choreographer whose television work includes Strictly Come Dancing. He joined the BBC series in 2018 and performed with celebrity partners across several series. His stage career also includes touring with Burn the Floor, bringing ballroom and Latin dance to theatre audiences as well as television viewers.
greg-james-radio-presenter-dj: Greg James is a British radio presenter, broadcaster and author best known for his work on BBC Radio 1, including its Breakfast Show. His television credits include Sounds Like Friday Night. Alongside broadcasting, he has collaborated with Chris Smith on the Kid Normal children's books, extending their on-air partnership into fiction and storytelling for younger readers.
gwyneth-strong-actress: Gwyneth Strong is a British actress best known for playing Cassandra in Only Fools and Horses. The character became Rodney Trotter's partner and wife, placing her at the centre of many of the sitcom's family storylines. Her acting career began with theatre work at London's Royal Court, and her screen credits also include the film Nothing but the Night.
harry-gration-presenter: Harry Gration was a British journalist and broadcaster closely associated with BBC Yorkshire's Look North. His career also included sports presenting, with credits on the Super League Show, Match of the Day and Ski Sunday. A familiar face to viewers across Yorkshire, he died in 2022. His work across regional news and sports coverage made him a much-loved figure in Yorkshire broadcasting.
hayley-mills-actress: Hayley Mills is a British actress whose career began with the film Tiger Bay. She became an internationally recognised child star through Disney films including Pollyanna and The Parent Trap, in which she played twin sisters. Her other film work includes Whistle Down the Wind. The daughter of actor John Mills and writer Mary Hayley Bell, she has worked across film, television and theatre.
howard-middeton-great-british-bake-off: Howard Middleton is a British baker, food writer and presenter from Sheffield who appeared in the fourth series of The Great British Bake Off. His baking is associated with unusual ingredients and a creative approach to gluten-free recipes. Beyond the programme, he has taught baking classes, demonstrated at food festivals and contributed writing to Great British Chefs.
hugh-bonneville-actor: Hugh Bonneville is a British actor best known for playing Robert Crawley, Earl of Grantham, in Downton Abbey. His career also includes film, television comedy and theatre, with credits ranging from Iris to Mr Stink and The Gold. He began his professional stage career at Regent's Park Open Air Theatre and is also the author of Playing Under the Piano.
iain-stirling-love-island-voice: Iain Stirling is a Scottish comedian, writer and broadcaster known for narrating Love Island. His television work also includes presenting The Dog Ate My Homework and writing and starring in the sitcom Buffering. Originally from Edinburgh, he has built a career across stand-up and screen comedy, combining live performance with the commentary and voice work familiar to television audiences.
ian-waite-dancer: Ian Waite is a British professional dancer, teacher and choreographer known for his work on Strictly Come Dancing. Specialising in Latin American dance, he has combined competitive dance experience with television performances and touring stage shows. His live work includes The Ballroom Boys with Vincent Simone, bringing ballroom entertainment to theatre audiences beyond the television dancefloor.
james-burrows-actor: James Burrows is a British actor from Derby best known for playing Ali Neeson in Coronation Street between 2018 and 2020. His television credits also include Safe House and Mount Pleasant. His career spans soap opera and other television drama, with the role of Michelle Connor's son introducing him to a wide audience on the ITV series.
james-quinn-actor: James Quinn is a British actor, writer and voice performer from Manchester, known for playing Phil in Early Doors and DS Keith Willets in Coronation Street. His screen credits include Fat Friends, Safe, Gentleman Jack and Apostasy. He has also worked in BBC radio drama and as a matchday commentator for FC United of Manchester's television and radio coverage.
james-redmond-actor: James Redmond is a British actor, presenter, comedian and former model best known for his roles as Rory Finnigan in Hollyoaks and Abs Denham in Casualty. He began his modelling career in Milan before moving into television. His work spans acting and live entertainment, with his soap and medical-drama roles making him familiar to British television audiences.
jamie-lomas-actor: Jamie Lomas is a British actor best known for playing Warren Fox in Hollyoaks and Jake Stone in EastEnders. Born in Manchester, he has worked across British television drama, with his soap roles bringing him to a wide audience. His career includes appearances in Coronation Street, alongside the long-running association with Hollyoaks for which he is particularly recognised.
jamie-vardy-leicester-city-england-footb: Jamie Vardy is an English footballer whose rise from non-League football to Leicester City made him one of the Premier League's best-known strikers. His early clubs included Stocksbridge Park Steels, FC Halifax Town and Fleetwood Town. He helped Leicester become Premier League champions in 2016 and also represented England, taking his career from local football to the international stage.
janette-manara-dancer: Janette Manrara is an American dancer and television presenter from Miami, known to British audiences through Strictly Come Dancing. Her dance background includes salsa, ballroom, ballet and other styles, alongside experience on So You Think You Can Dance. Before becoming a full-time performer, she studied finance and worked in banking while continuing her dance training.
jason-mohammed-bbc-sport: Jason Mohammad is a Welsh television and radio presenter known for BBC programmes including Final Score and Wales Today. His sports broadcasting has included snooker, football and rugby coverage, with work on events such as the World Snooker Championship and Six Nations. Born in Cardiff, he has built a career covering both news and sport for Welsh and wider UK audiences.
jeff-mostyn-bournemouth-fc-chairman: Jeff Mostyn is a British businessman and former chairman of AFC Bournemouth, associated with the club's rise through the Football League to the Premier League. His work has included leadership and ambassadorial roles with the Cherries. He has also shared his experiences of business and football in public talks and in his book The Chairman: The Man Who Saved AFC Bournemouth.
jemma-lucy-reality-star: Jemma Lucy is a British television personality and model known for appearing in the third and fifth series of MTV's Ex on the Beach. Her reality television credits also include Celebrity Big Brother in 2017 and Signed by Katie Price. Her screen career developed across several entertainment formats, with Ex on the Beach introducing her to a wider television audience.
jeremy-vine-radio-presenter: Jeremy Vine is a British journalist and broadcaster whose career spans BBC radio, television news and entertainment. He is known for his BBC Radio 2 programme, political reporting and election coverage, and presenting Points of View. He has also appeared as a contestant on Strictly Come Dancing, moving between current-affairs broadcasting and lighter television formats throughout his career.
jermaine-jenus-footballer: Jermaine Jenas is an English former professional footballer whose playing career included Nottingham Forest, Newcastle United, Tottenham Hotspur and Queens Park Rangers. A midfielder, he also represented England at international level. Following his playing career, he moved into football commentary, punditry and television presenting, bringing his experience of professional football to audiences beyond the pitch.
jez-edwards-tv-presenter: Jez Edwards is a British actor and voice performer whose television credits include ChuckleVision and the comedy series Stupid. He has also voiced Cormac in the British version of the children's animation Chuggington. His work combines on-screen character performances with voice acting, bringing him to audiences through both live-action comedy and programmes made for younger viewers.
jimmy-cricket-comedian: Jimmy Cricket is the stage name of James Mulgrew, a Northern Irish comedian known for family entertainment and live comic storytelling. He has worked in television, radio and live shows. His touring career has included appearances alongside entertainers such as Cannon and Ball, Frank Carson and The Krankies.
jimmy-white-snooker-player: Jimmy White is an English snooker player known as the Whirlwind and one of the sport's most familiar crowd favourites. His career includes ten ranking titles and six appearances in the World Championship final. He won the UK Championship in 1992 and made a maximum break at that year's World Championship, becoming the first left-handed player to achieve a Crucible 147.
joanne-clifton-dancer: Joanne Clifton is a British dancer, singer and actress whose career spans competitive ballroom dance, television and musical theatre. She won Strictly Come Dancing in 2016 with celebrity partner Ore Oduba. Her performing experience also includes Burn the Floor and stage musicals, building on an international ballroom career that included the World Ballroom Showdance Championship title.
joe-tasker-and-harpz-kaur-tv-presenter: Joe Tasker and Harpz Kaur are British broadcasters who presented CBBC's Saturday Mash-Up!, bringing games, guests and live entertainment to younger viewers. Tasker is also known for his online comedy videos and social-media content, while Kaur's broadcasting career includes BBC Asian Network. Their shared television work brought together their different backgrounds in digital entertainment and radio presenting.
joel-ross-radio-presenter: Joel Ross is a British radio and television presenter best known as one half of the broadcasting duo JK and Joel, alongside Jason King. The pair hosted BBC Radio 1's Official Chart and appeared in children's television programmes including Hider in the House. His wider career includes breakfast radio and entertainment presenting, following his early work with the duo.
johannes-radebe-dancer: Johannes Radebe is a South African dancer and choreographer known for his performances on Strictly Come Dancing. His career began in competitive ballroom and Latin dance and includes work with the touring production Burn the Floor. In 2021, he partnered John Whaite in Strictly's first all-male competitive pairing, bringing the partnership to the final of the BBC series.
john-challis-actor: John Challis was a British actor best known for playing Boycie in Only Fools and Horses and its spin-off The Green Green Grass. His television career also included Monty in Benidorm, alongside extensive theatre work. He performed in National Theatre productions and touring plays, and died in 2021. His distinctive comic characters remain familiar to generations of television viewers.
john-marquez-actor: John Marquez is a British actor best known for playing PC Joe Penhale in ITV's Doc Martin and Ray Wilson in the BBC drama In the Club. His screen career includes television comedy and drama, alongside other acting work. Born in Coventry, he is also part of an acting family, with his brother Martin Marquez working in stage and television productions.
john-sopel-correspondent: Jon Sopel is a British journalist, broadcaster and author who served as the BBC's North America editor for eight years. In 2022, he launched The News Agents podcast with Emily Maitlis and Lewis Goodall. His books include If Only They Didn't Speak English and A Year at the Circus, drawing on his experience reporting on American politics and the White House.
john-whaite-bake-off-winner: John Whaite is a British baker, author and television personality who won the third series of The Great British Bake Off in 2012. His career developed into food writing and broadcasting after the competition. In 2021, he reached the Strictly Come Dancing final with Johannes Radebe, forming the first all-male competitive partnership in the programme's history.
johnny-ball-tv-presenter: Johnny Ball is a British broadcaster and writer known for making mathematics and science accessible to younger audiences. His television programmes include Play School, Think of a Number and Think Again, combining explanation with games and demonstrations. His work has also extended to books and public appearances, encouraging audiences to explore numbers and scientific ideas with curiosity and humour.
johnny-hates-jazz-singers: Johnny Hates Jazz are a British pop group associated with singer-songwriter Clark Datchler and producer Mike Nocito. They achieved international success with Shattered Dreams in 1987 and became known for polished pop songwriting and production. Their recording history includes work with the original line-up as well as later releases, linking their 1980s breakthrough with a continuing catalogue of music.
johnny-vegas-actor-comedian: Johnny Vegas is the stage name of Michael Pennington, a British comedian and actor known for his distinctive voice and surreal comic performances. His television roles include Moz in Ideal, Geoff Maltby in Benidorm and Eric Agnew in Still Open All Hours. His career spans stand-up, acting, writing and directing, combining live comedy with recognisable television characters.
jonathan-dimbleby-tv-host: Jonathan Dimbleby is a British broadcaster, author and historian whose career includes current-affairs programmes on radio and television. He is known for BBC Radio 4's Any Questions? and documentary presenting, including Russia: A Journey with Jonathan Dimbleby. The son of broadcaster Richard Dimbleby and brother of David Dimbleby, he has also written books alongside his journalism and presenting work.
jonathan-swain-gmb-reporter: Jonathan Swain is a British broadcast journalist known for reporting on ITV's Good Morning Britain. His career in breakfast television also includes GMTV and Daybreak, covering stories through live reports and correspondent work. His screen credits include ITV news coverage and special broadcasts, reflecting a career spent reporting for audiences across several generations of morning television.
jorgie-porter-actress: Jorgie Porter is a British actress best known for playing Theresa McQueen in Hollyoaks. She joined the Channel 4 soap in 2008, with the character becoming part of the programme's McQueen family. Her wider television work includes the BBC revival of Are You Being Served?, alongside appearances in entertainment programmes, extending her profile beyond the role that first made her familiar to soap viewers.
ken-docherty-snooker-player: Ken Doherty is an Irish snooker player and broadcaster whose career includes winning the World Snooker Championship in 1997. Before his professional success, he won the World Amateur and World Under-21 titles. His career also includes commentary and radio presenting, combining his experience as a player with broadcasting work and a long association with international snooker.
kevin-kennedy-actor: Kevin Kennedy is a British actor and musician best known for playing Norman 'Curly' Watts in Coronation Street. He portrayed the character for twenty years, becoming a familiar part of the ITV soap's comic and dramatic storylines. His career has also included music and stage work, alongside television appearances such as his role in the BBC medical drama Holby City.
lauren-oakley-dancer: Lauren Oakley is a British professional dancer and choreographer from Birmingham who joined Strictly Come Dancing in 2022. Her earlier career included competitive ballroom and Latin dance, followed by stage performance and dance-captain work with Burn the Floor. Her television and theatre appearances build on that dance background, bringing experience from competition and touring productions to the BBC ballroom.
lauren-steadman-paralympic-athlete: Lauren Steadman is a British Paralympic athlete whose sporting career spans swimming and paratriathlon. After competing as a swimmer, she moved into triathlon and won gold in the women's PTS5 event at the Tokyo Paralympic Games. She added bronze at Paris 2024, alongside achievements at World and European Championships, building an international career across two different Paralympic sports.
laurie-brett-actress: Laurie Brett is a Scottish actress best known for playing Jane Beale in EastEnders and Christine Mulgrew in Waterloo Road. Her television career also includes The Bill and My Hero, while her stage work has included a touring production of Band of Gold. She has worked across soap opera, drama and theatre, bringing a range of characters to television and live audiences.
liesl-radio-presenter: Liesl Soards is a British radio presenter, producer and writer associated with Hallam FM and Hits Radio. She worked alongside Big John Harrison and producer James Crookes on the South Yorkshire breakfast show, with the team also continuing their partnership through podcasting. Her wider broadcasting background includes BBC work, alongside writing and live hosting away from the radio studio.
lisa-maxwell-actress: Lisa Maxwell is a British actress, presenter and voice performer best known for playing Samantha Nixon in The Bill. Her television career includes The Lisa Maxwell Show and other comedy and drama appearances. She also provided the voice of Kira in The Dark Crystal, giving her a screen career that combines live-action roles, entertainment presenting and character voice work.
lorna-fitzgerald-actress: Lorna Fitzgerald is a British actress best known for playing Abi Branning in EastEnders. Originally from Northampton, she developed her television career on the BBC soap before moving into further stage and screen work after leaving in 2018. Her later screen credits include London Kills and The Loss Adjuster, extending her acting work beyond the character familiar to soap audiences.
louise-rednapp-singer: Louise Redknapp is a British singer and performer who first became known as a member of Eternal, the R&B group behind the album Always & Forever. She subsequently developed a solo recording career and worked in television entertainment. Her career also includes reaching the final of Strictly Come Dancing in 2016, bringing her performance experience from pop music into ballroom and Latin dance.
marc-elliott-actor: Marc Elliott is a British actor known for playing Syed Masood in EastEnders and Isaac Mayfield in Holby City. His performance in EastEnders earned him a British Soap Award, while his career also includes theatre work, such as The History Boys. Originally from Stratford-upon-Avon, he has worked across stage and screen, moving between soap opera, drama and live productions.
bez-singer: Bez is the stage name of Mark Berry, the British dancer and percussionist associated with Happy Mondays and Black Grape. Recognisable for his maracas and distinctive dance style, he became part of the Manchester music scene's public identity. His wider career includes DJ work and television appearances, extending the profile he established through his performances with the bands.
mark-read-a1-singer: Mark Read is a British singer, songwriter and musician best known as a member of the British-Norwegian pop group a1. The band's catalogue includes the UK number-one singles Take On Me and Same Old Brand New You. Read is also credited as a co-writer of Same Old Brand New You, combining his performing role in the group with songwriting.
mark-watson-comedian: Mark Watson is a British comedian and author whose career includes stand-up performance, writing and television comedy. He won the Daily Telegraph Open Mic competition in 2002, the year he began performing comedy. His work has since included touring shows, books and festival appearances, combining live performance with writing for audiences beyond the comedy stage.
martin-fry-abc: Martin Fry is a British singer and songwriter best known as the lead vocalist of ABC. The group's breakthrough album The Lexicon of Love reached number one in the UK in 1982. Their songs include The Look of Love and When Smokey Sings, placing Fry's voice at the centre of a catalogue associated with polished pop and the 1980s music scene.
maxwell-thorpe-bgt-finalist: Maxwell Thorpe is a British singer who reached the final of Britain's Got Talent in 2022. Associated with Sheffield's busking scene, he brought his operatic singing to a national television audience through the competition. His performances connected the experience of singing in public spaces with the scale of a televised talent show, introducing viewers to his classical vocal style.
megan-mckenna-reality-star: Megan McKenna is a British singer and television personality who first became widely known through reality programmes including Ex on the Beach and The Only Way Is Essex. She developed a recording career with her debut album Story of Me in 2018. In 2019, she won The X Factor: Celebrity, bringing her singing to a wider television audience.
mike-bushell-presenter: Mike Bushell is a British sports broadcaster known for his work on BBC Breakfast. His television career has included presenting sports news and features, helping bring sporting stories to a general morning audience. Alongside his broadcasting, he appeared as a contestant on Strictly Come Dancing in 2019, moving from reporting on physical challenges to learning ballroom and Latin routines himself.
mitchel-taylor-ella-barnes-reality-tv: Mitchel Taylor and Ella Barnes are British television personalities who appeared in the summer 2023 series of Love Island. Taylor entered the programme with a background as a gas engineer from Sheffield, while Barnes was introduced as a dancer and model from Kent. The programme introduced both contestants to a wider television audience through its villa challenges and relationships.
mo-gilligan-comedian: Mo Gilligan is a British comedian and television presenter who developed a wide audience through online comedy before moving into major television projects. His work includes The Lateish Show with Mo Gilligan, judging on The Masked Singer and hosting the BRIT Awards. His Netflix special Momentum also brought his stand-up to international viewers, alongside his live performances and broadcasting work.
molly-mae-love-island: Molly-Mae Hague is a British television personality and content creator who became widely known through Love Island in 2019. She finished as a runner-up in the fifth series of the revived programme. Her career developed beyond reality television into online content and business projects, making her familiar to audiences through both television appearances and her digital channels.
natalie-davies-actress: Natalie Davies is a British actress from Bradford whose screen work includes Ashley in Channel 4's Hullraisers. Her other credits include Coronation Street, Eaten by Lions and the television continuation of The Full Monty. Her career spans comedy and drama, with roles in both film and television productions connecting her Yorkshire roots with a wider screen audience.
neil-jones-dancer: Neil Jones is a British professional dancer and choreographer known for his work on Strictly Come Dancing, which he joined in 2016. His dance background includes national and world championship achievements in Latin dance. His Strictly work has included group routines, celebrity partnerships and specials, bringing experience from competitive dance to television entertainment and live performance.
neil-mcdermott-eastenders-actor: Neil McDermott is a British stage and television actor best known for playing Ryan Malloy in EastEnders. His screen credits also include Doctor Who and The Royal. Alongside television drama, he has worked in musical theatre, including The Sound of Music, combining acting with stage performance and extending his career beyond the role familiar to BBC soap viewers.
nev-wilshire-tv-personality: Nev Wilshire was a British businessman and television personality known for the BBC documentary series The Call Centre. The programme followed working life in a Swansea call centre, with his management style becoming a central part of the series. He later appeared in Nev's Indian Call Centre. His television appearances took his distinctive approach to management to a wider audience. He died in 2021.
nigel-ng-comedian: Nigel Ng is a Malaysian comedian and online performer best known for creating Uncle Roger. The character's reactions to cooking videos introduced his comedy to a large international audience. His career also includes stand-up performances and television appearances, combining live comedy with the online sketches and commentary that made Uncle Roger a recognisable name across social media.
paul-barber-actor: Paul Barber is a British actor from Liverpool best known for playing Denzil in Only Fools and Horses and Horse in The Full Monty. His film career also includes Porridge, The Long Good Friday and The 51st State. His work spans comedy and drama, with his television and film characters making him familiar to several generations of audiences.
paul-burrell-royal-butler: Paul Burrell is a British author and television personality who worked in the Royal Household, including as a footman to Queen Elizabeth II and butler to Diana, Princess of Wales. His writing draws on his experiences in royal service, with memoirs bringing those years to a wider readership. His later career has included television appearances and public discussion of royal life.
paul-martin-tv-personality: Paul Martin is a British antiques dealer and television presenter best known for the BBC series Flog It! His presenting credits also include Trust Me, I'm a Dealer and Paul Martin's Handmade Revolution. His broadcasting work explores antiques, collecting and craftsmanship, drawing on his experience in the trade. Away from presenting and dealing, his background also includes work as a musician.
pippa-tarrant-broadcaster: Pippa Tarrant is a British radio producer and broadcaster associated with The Chris Moyles Show on Radio X. Also known professionally as Pippa Taylor, she has worked in radio production and presenting, with earlier experience at BBC Radio 1. Her career includes executive-producing the Radio X programme, combining work behind the scenes with contributions familiar to the show's listeners.
raven-chapman-terri-harper-stevi-levy-bo: Raven Chapman, Terri Harper and Stevi Levy are British professional boxers represented together in this group entry. Harper has won world titles across multiple weight divisions, while Chapman has competed at featherweight world-title level. Levy, known as Super Stevi, is associated with King's Lynn. Together, the three fighters represent different paths through professional boxing, from domestic competition to world championship bouts.
reginald-d-hunter-comedian: Reginald D. Hunter is an American stand-up comedian who established his career in the UK after travelling to London to study acting. His comedy work includes live performances, touring shows and television appearances. Originally from the United States, he brings that perspective to his observations about British life, culture and everyday situations, combining storytelling with stand-up performance.
richard-blackwood-actor: Richard Blackwood is a British comedian, actor and presenter best known for playing Vincent Hubbard in EastEnders and Felix Westwood in Hollyoaks. His career has also included music and entertainment presenting. Moving between comedy, soap opera and stage work, he has built a screen profile that spans both scripted drama and programmes featuring him as a performer and host.
richard-curts-writer: Richard Curtis is a British screenwriter, producer and director known for romantic comedies including Four Weddings and a Funeral, Notting Hill and Love Actually. His film work also includes Bridget Jones's Diary and About Time. His career combines writing with directing and production, helping shape several of the most recognisable British screen comedies of the past few decades.
rob-rouse-comedian-presenter: Rob Rouse is a British comedian and actor known for playing Bottom in the BBC sitcom Upstart Crow. Before entering comedy, he trained as a geography teacher, then won the So You Think You're Funny? competition in 1998. His television work also includes The Friday Night Project and Grownups, alongside touring stand-up and comedy-club performances.
rose-ayling-ellis-actress: Rose Ayling-Ellis is a British actress and presenter who played Frankie Lewis in EastEnders. In 2021, she became the first deaf winner of Strictly Come Dancing, partnering Giovanni Pernice. A British Sign Language user, she has also presented the documentary Signs for Change, bringing her experience to television work exploring deaf identity and communication alongside her acting career.
roy-hodgeson-crystal-palace-football-man: Roy Hodgson is an English football manager and former player whose coaching career has included club and international teams across several countries. His work began with Halmstads in Sweden in 1976 and later included Crystal Palace and other English clubs. His career is associated with decades of football management, spanning different leagues and football cultures rather than a single team.
sam-lightfoot-boxer: Sam Lightfoot is a British boxer whose background includes competition in England Boxing's amateur championships. Representing Yorkshire clubs, she competed in national events before moving into professional boxing. Her progression reflects the route from amateur competition to the professional sport, with training and experience in the amateur ring providing the foundation for the next stage of her boxing career.
samantha-bumford: Samantha Bumford is a British pageant titleholder from Poole who was crowned Miss Dorset in 2017. At the time of her win, she supported the Dorset assistance-dog charity Woofability and helped train a puppy called Binxy. Her public appearances also included Bournemouth's Metropole Market celebrations, linking her pageant role with community events and local charitable activity.
sandra-marvin-actress: Sandra Marvin is a British actress and singer whose television work includes Jessie Grant in Emmerdale and appearances in Call the Midwife. Her musical-theatre roles include Deloris in Sister Act, Queenie in Show Boat and Motormouth Maybelle in Hairspray. She has also played Becky in Waitress, combining screen acting with leading roles in West End and touring productions.
sara-cox-radio-dj: Sara Joanne Cyzer, professionally known as Sara Cox, is an English broadcaster and model. She hosts the BBC Radio 2 Breakfast Show, having previously presented the station's Drivetime programme. She presented the BBC Radio 1 Breakfast Show between 3 April 2000 and 19 December 2003.
sara-davies-dragon: Sara Davies is a British entrepreneur and television personality who founded Crafter's Companion while studying at the University of York. She became known to a wider audience as an investor on Dragons' Den and has also appeared on Strictly Come Dancing. Her career combines business with broadcasting and writing, drawing on the craft company she established as a student.
sasha-parkinson-actress: Sacha Parkinson is a British actress best known for playing Sian Powers in Coronation Street. Her screen work also includes The Mill, The Driver, Mr Selfridge and Safe House. She began acting as a child and has appeared in films including Awaydays and A Boy Called Dad, developing a career across television drama, soap opera and independent cinema.
scott-robinson-singer: Scott Robinson is a British singer and radio presenter best known as a member of Five. The group's songs include Keep On Movin' and Everybody Get Up, combining pop vocals with the sound that established them in the late 1990s. His performing career is closely associated with the band's recordings and live appearances, alongside work in broadcasting.
seann-walsh-comedian: Seann Walsh is a British stand-up comedian and actor whose work includes live comedy, touring performances and television entertainment. His screen projects include Seann Walsh World and Seann Walsh's Late Night Comedy Spectacular. His performances draw on observations about everyday life, combining the storytelling of his stand-up shows with appearances in television comedy and other entertainment formats.
shane-richie-actor-singer: Shane Richie is a British actor, comedian and presenter best known for playing Alfie Moon in EastEnders. His acting work includes the spin-off drama Redwater and a voice role in the animated film Flushed Away. He has also performed in musical theatre, including Everybody's Talking About Jamie, combining his television profile with stage entertainment and live performance.
shaun-williamson-barry-eastenders-actor: Shaun Williamson is a British actor and singer best known for playing Barry Evans in EastEnders. He later appeared in Extras as a comic version of himself, often referred to as Barry from EastEnders. His other screen work includes Scoop and The Invention of Lying, with a career that combines soap drama, comedy and performance beyond the original character.
shelley-king-actress: Shelley King is a British actress known for playing Yasmeen Nazir in Coronation Street and Jay Harper in the BBC drama Angels. Her career includes screen and theatre work, with television appearances ranging from soap opera to drama. Her portrayal of Yasmeen introduced her to a large ITV audience, adding to the earlier roles that established her acting career.
simon-rimmer-presenter-chef: Simon Rimmer is a British chef, restaurateur and television presenter known for his on-screen partnership with Tim Lovejoy. The pair have presented Sunday Brunch on Channel 4 and previously worked together on Something for the Weekend. Rimmer's wider television credits include food and cookery programmes, drawing on his restaurant experience while combining recipes with interviews and entertainment.
sir-michael-palin: Sir Michael Palin is a British comedian, actor, writer and travel presenter who first became widely known as a member of Monty Python. His film work includes A Fish Called Wanda, while his travel series include Around the World in 80 Days, Pole to Pole and Himalaya. His career connects comedy and storytelling with documentaries exploring places and people across the world.
soraya-vivian-singer: Soraya Vivian is a British singer and songwriter whose career includes dance music, club performances and Pride events. Her vocals have featured in recordings and live appearances associated with the dance scene. In 2023, she sang the Ukrainian Pride anthem Colours of Love. Her work also includes LGBTQ+ advocacy, connecting her performances with community events and celebrations.
steff-todd-comedian: Steff Todd is a British comedian, actress and impressionist known for her online Yorkshire Kardashians sketches. Her television credits include The Stand Up Sketch Show and the BBC sitcom Scarborough, in which she played Jess. Her work moves between live stand-up, character comedy and social-media performances, using impressions to bring familiar personalities into a distinctly Yorkshire setting.
steph-mcgovern: Steph McGovern is a British journalist and television presenter known for her business reporting on BBC Breakfast and for hosting Channel 4's Steph's Packed Lunch from 2020 to 2023. Her broadcasting career also includes consumer and entertainment programmes such as Shop Well for Less? and Watchdog. Her work combines reporting with studio presenting and discussion across a range of subjects.
stephanie-hirst-radio-presenter: Stephanie Hirst is a British broadcaster and DJ known for presenting Hirsty's Daily Dose on Capital Yorkshire and the national chart show Hit40UK. Her radio career also includes BBC Radio Leeds, Hits Radio and Greatest Hits Radio. Away from broadcasting, she works as a public speaker, drawing on her career and personal experiences in her Believe Achieve talks.
stephen-hendry-snooker-player: Stephen Hendry is a Scottish former professional snooker player who won seven World Championship titles. His first came in 1990, when he became the youngest world champion, and he was a dominant figure in the sport during the 1990s. His later work includes broadcasting and Stephen Hendry's Cue Tips, sharing playing advice, interviews and reflections on his career.
steve-davis-snoker-player: Steve Davis is an English former professional snooker player who won six World Championship titles during the 1980s. His career also included multiple UK Championship and Masters victories before his retirement in 2016. Beyond the table, he has worked as a commentator, author and musician, combining his experience in snooker with interests in broadcasting and electronic music.
steve-lamacq-radio-dj: Steve Lamacq is a British radio presenter and music journalist known for championing new bands and alternative music. His broadcasting career includes BBC Radio 1 and BBC Radio 6 Music, where he developed a long association with music programming. His work connects interviews, records and live sessions, introducing listeners to emerging performers as well as established artists.
steve-royal-comedian: Steve Royle is a British comedian, actor and juggler who reached the final of Britain's Got Talent in 2020. His work combines physical comedy, juggling and stand-up, alongside radio presenting and pantomime appearances. He also performed in Phoenix Nights Live at Manchester Arena, bringing his variety-show skills to a large live audience as well as television viewers.
stu-francis-personality: Stu Francis is a British comedian and entertainer best known for presenting the children's television programme Crackerjack in the early 1980s. His catchphrases include 'Ooh, I could crush a grape!', which also became the title of a later television show. His career developed through holiday-camp entertainment, live comedy and theatre, before bringing his distinctive variety style to television.
stuart-maconie-radio-presenter: Stuart Maconie is a British broadcaster, author and music journalist known for his partnership with Mark Radcliffe and for The Freak Zone on BBC Radio 6 Music. His books include Cider with Roadies and Pies and Prejudice, exploring music, culture and life in Britain. His career combines radio presenting with writing, bringing commentary and storytelling to both listeners and readers.
sydnie-christmas-bgt-winner: Sydnie Christmas is a British singer who won Britain's Got Talent in 2024. She was working in a gym when she auditioned for the programme, which introduced her singing to a national audience. Her journey from the audition stage to winning the seventeenth series made her one of the show's recognisable performers, with musical theatre among her ambitions.
tasha-ghouri-tv-personality: Tasha Ghouri is a British dancer, model and television personality who became known through Love Island in 2022. She later competed on Strictly Come Dancing in 2024, reaching the final with Aljaž Škorjanec. Her public work also includes raising awareness of deaf representation, bringing her experience to discussions alongside her appearances in reality television and dance entertainment.
terry-giffiths-snooker-player: Terry Griffiths was a Welsh snooker player, coach and commentator who won the World Championship in 1979 after coming through qualifying. He reached the final again in 1988 and later became known for coaching and broadcasting. His career connected tournament success with helping other players develop their games. He died in 2024, leaving a long association with international snooker.
terry-waite-journalist-writer: Terry Waite is a British humanitarian, author and former envoy for the Archbishop of Canterbury. His work included negotiating for hostages overseas before he was himself held captive in Lebanon from 1987 to 1991. He wrote about his experiences in Taken on Trust and has continued working through writing, speaking and charitable activity, including support for organisations helping families and communities.
tilly-ramsey-tv-personality: Tilly Ramsay is a British cook and television presenter best known for the CBBC series Matilda and the Ramsay Bunch. The programme featured cooking alongside her family's activities, introducing her to younger viewers. Her screen work also includes MasterChef Junior and Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted Showdown, developing a broadcasting career around food, practical cooking and family entertainment.
tim-healy-actor: Tim Healy is a British actor best known for playing Dennis Patterson in Auf Wiedersehen, Pet. His television roles also include Les in Benidorm and Gastric in Still Open All Hours. His career has combined comedy and drama, with those contrasting characters bringing him to different generations of viewers across several long-running and widely recognised British television programmes.
tim-peake-astronaut: Tim Peake is a British astronaut and former Army Air Corps officer who travelled to the International Space Station on the European Space Agency's Principia mission. His spaceflight began in December 2015 and included a spacewalk during his stay in orbit. Before becoming an astronaut, he worked as a military pilot and test pilot, bringing aviation experience to his space career.
tracy-brabin-mp-actress: Tracy Brabin is a British politician and former actress who was elected the first Mayor of West Yorkshire in 2021. She previously served as MP for Batley and Spen from 2016 to 2021. Her earlier career included film and television acting, with screen credits such as Riff-Raff and Love + Hate, connecting her public life in politics with experience in the creative industries.
viper-gladiator: Viper is the Gladiators persona of actor and fitness model Quang Luong. Appearing in the BBC revival of the physical competition series, the character is presented as an intense opponent who lets his athletic performance do the talking. Luong's work combines television entertainment with fitness and acting, making Viper one of the recognisable figures in the programme's line-up.
vogue-williams-model: Vogue Williams is an Irish presenter, model and media personality whose television career includes winning Bear Grylls: Mission Survive in 2015. She is also known for co-hosting the podcast My Therapist Ghosted Me with comedian Joanne McNally. Her work spans television, audio and live events, bringing her presenting experience into conversations, entertainment programmes and podcast performances.
wendi-peters-actress: Wendi Peters is a British actress best known for playing Cilla Battersby-Brown in Coronation Street. Her television career also includes Nina Bulsara in Doctors and appearances in Bad Girls. Alongside screen work, she has performed in theatre productions including Guys and Dolls and Into the Woods, building an acting career that combines television characters with stage performance.
willie-thorne-snooker-player: Willie Thorne was an English snooker player and commentator whose career included winning the 1985 Classic. He became familiar to audiences through tournament play and television broadcasting during the sport's rise in popularity. He also ran a snooker centre in Leicester. His broadcasting work introduced his knowledge of the game to viewers long after his tournament breakthrough. He died in 2020.
wim-snape-actor: Wim Snape is a British actor from Sheffield best known for playing Nathan in the 1997 film The Full Monty. Credited in that film as William Snape, he returned to the role in the 2023 television continuation. His other screen work includes Coronation Street and The Beaker Girls, linking his early film performance with later television acting.
wynne-evans-radio-presenter: Wynne Evans is a Welsh opera singer, broadcaster and actor known for portraying Gio Compario in Go.Compare's television adverts. His recording work includes the album A Song in My Heart. He also won Celebrity MasterChef in 2023, bringing his profile beyond music into television competition. His career connects operatic performance with broadcasting and widely recognised advertising work.
